summary.text: Lynn Copeland is a Democratic state representative from Saco, Maine, who has represented District 130 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is retired, and her career experience includes work as a legal assistant and as a therapeutic foster parent.

paragraphs.text: Copeland was born in Huntington, New York, and lives in Saco, Maine.

Her career experience includes owning Lynnie's Landing and working as a legal assistant with the Bernstein Shur law firm, a wedding officiant with the State of Maine Notary Public and a therapeutic foster parent with KidsPeace.
She chaired the Saco Conservation Committee.
Copeland took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists the State and Local Government Committee as her committee assignment for 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been elected by her community in Saco five times, twice to the Saco City Council and three times to the Maine House.
Copeland listed affordability, equal rights and prioritizing youth as the key messages of her campaign in the survey.
She said she has co-sponsored the Equal Rights Amendment in the Maine Legislature and is working on a bill to bring film production to Maine.
